parameters.name: BurstStatus
parameters.description: Set this parameter to **disabled** to disable the committed Serverless feature.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: CpuEnlargeThreshold
parameters.description: The CPU utilization threshold for elastic **scale-out**. Valid values: 60 to 90. Unit: %.

parameters.name: CpuShrinkThreshold
parameters.description: The CPU utilization threshold for elastic **scale-in**. Valid values: 30 to 55. Unit: %.

parameters.name: CrontabJobId
parameters.description: A reserved parameter. This parameter is not supported.

parameters.name: MemoryEnlargeThreshold
parameters.description: The memory utilization threshold for elastic **scale-out**. Valid values: 60 to 90. Unit: %.

parameters.name: MemoryShrinkThreshold
parameters.description: The memory utilization threshold for elastic **scale-in**. Valid values: 30 to 55. Unit: %.

parameters.name: ScaleMaxCpus
parameters.description: The maximum number of CPUs for elastic scale-out. The value can be up to twice the initial CPU configuration of the instance.

parameters.name: ScaleMaxMemory
parameters.description: The maximum memory for elastic scale-out. The value can be up to twice the initial memory configuration of the instance. Unit: GB. The value is adjusted in increments of 2 GB.

parameters.name: SwitchTime
parameters.description:
The point in time at which the modification takes effect. Format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC).
> This parameter is required when **SwitchTimeMode** is set to **2**.

parameters.name: SwitchTimeMode
parameters.description:
The time at which the modification takes effect. Valid values:
- **0**: The modification takes effect immediately.
- **1**: The modification takes effect during the maintenance window. You can call the **ModifyDBInstanceMaintainTime** operation to modify the maintenance window.
- **2**: The modification takes effect at a specified point in time.

parameters.name: TaskId
parameters.description: A reserved parameter. This parameter is not supported.
